 First Wave of Acts Announced for When We Were Young 2027
 by 
 Marianne Eloise | 
 November 17, 2026 
 Looks like we’ll be heading back out to Vegas–the first wave of acts have been announced for When We Were Young Festival 2027, and it’s set to be a huge one.
 Credit: Justin Agoncillo 
 Blink-182 and Pierce the Veil will be headlining at the Las Vegas festival grounds. The lineup also includes All Time Low, Limp Bizkit, The Used, New Found Glory, Circa Survive, Simple Plan, 5 Seconds of Summer, Taking Back Sunday, Sleeping With Sirens and more–with more set to be announced. The festival will take place on 16th October 2027.
 See you in the desert.
Presale begins Friday 20th November here .
